notes: Cozy pixel-art interface chrome for the Sanctuary companion shell.
Assets are hand-authored SVGs (palette- and grid-compliant) so the chrome ships without an RD_API_KEY in CI.

Each entry below preserves the prompt + seed intent so future RD regenerations can produce a matching PNG/Aseprite drop-in without code changes — swap the file path on the same logical name and retain dimensions.
Palette anchors: deep #0d0a1c / #1a1430 backgrounds; warm #4a3a7e / #ffd070 frames; pink #ff99cc + cyan #88e0ff dust accents. Matches docs/SANCTUARY_STYLE_DOCTRINE.md.

rd_style.negative_prompt: blurry, photorealistic, smooth gradient, banding, text, watermark

assets.name: panel_frame
assets.intent: Base panel frame — neutral cozy purple with gold corner studs.
assets.prompt: A cozy pixel-art ornate panel frame, warm purple stone with tiny gold corner gemstones, soft inner shadow, transparent center, dungeon-fantasy UI, Stardew/Tamagotchi aesthetic, perfectly tileable edges.

assets.name: panel_frame_active
assets.intent: Active/selected panel — warm gold tones, used when a panel is the player's focus.
assets.prompt: Same cozy pixel-art panel frame as panel_frame, but glowing brighter gold-amber, like lantern-lit oak; transparent center; tileable.

assets.name: panel_frame_muted
assets.intent: Muted/disabled panel — desaturated indigo, low contrast.
assets.prompt: Same panel geometry as panel_frame but desaturated cool indigo, dim corner studs, soft and quiet, transparent center, tileable.

assets.name: button_outline
assets.intent: Outline for action buttons (feed/pet/talk/sleep/play). Replaces flat 2px border.
assets.prompt: A cozy pixel-art button outline, chamfered corners, faint highlight on top-left and shadow on bottom-right, lavender accent pixels in opposite corners, tileable, transparent center.

assets.name: focus_ring
assets.intent: :focus-visible ornament for buttons — gold rim with 4-pixel corner stars.
assets.prompt: A cozy pixel-art focus ring, slim warm-gold rim, four 4-pixel cross stars at the corners, tileable, transparent center.

assets.name: corner_flourish_a
assets.intent: Top-left flourish: small gold star with a purple curl tail and dust pixels.
assets.prompt: Tiny pixel-art ornament, golden 4-point star with a soft lavender ribbon curling inward, faint dust sparkles, transparent background, sized for a 16x16 corner accent.

assets.name: corner_flourish_b
assets.intent: Bottom-right flourish: lavender crescent with gold sparkle and cyan dust. Pairs with corner_flourish_a.
assets.prompt: Tiny pixel-art ornament, lavender crescent moon with a single gold sparkle and faint cyan dust pixels, transparent, sized for a 16x16 corner accent.

assets.name: dust_motif
assets.intent: Tileable horizontal dust strip — used as a divider above panel headings.
assets.prompt: A horizontal pixel-art dust strip with five tiny stars in gold, lavender, white, cyan, and pink, evenly spaced, repeats seamlessly, transparent background.

css_classes: .chrome-button — applies button_outline.svg via border-image; focus_ring.svg shown on :focus-visible
integration.reduced_motion: Decorative ornaments are static; no chrome class introduces motion. The existing prefers-reduced-motion rule in app/globals.css already neutralizes residual animation. Frames remain readable when motion is disabled.
